name: Magnification
formula: magnification = size of image ÷ size of real object
note: Make sure image size and real size are in the same units before dividing.

name: Rate of reaction (from a volume or count)
note: Used in the photosynthesis and enzyme practicals: rate = 1000 ÷ time is also common for time-to-completion data.

name: Percentage change in mass
formula: % change = (final mass − initial mass) ÷ initial mass × 100
note: A negative answer means the tissue lost mass (water left by osmosis).

name: Surface area to volume ratio (cube)
note: Simplify so the volume side is 1, e.g. 6 : 1 for a 1 cm cube, 3 : 1 for a 2 cm cube.

name: Estimating population size from quadrats
formula: population = (total organisms counted ÷ total area sampled) × total area
note: Use the mean number per quadrat, then scale up to the whole area.

name: Efficiency of biomass transfer
formula: efficiency = biomass transferred to next level ÷ biomass available at previous level × 100
note: Multiply the decimal by 100 to give a percentage. Separate Biology only.
